papers.title: A Contextual Bandit Approach for Stream-Based Active Learning
papers.abstract: Contextual bandit algorithms -- a class of multi-armed bandit algorithms that exploit the contextual information -- have been shown to be effective in solving sequential decision making problems under uncertainty. A common assumption adopted in the literature is that the realized (ground truth) reward by taking the selected action is observed by the learner at no cost, which, however, is not realistic in many practical scenarios. When observing the ground truth reward is costly, a key challenge for the learner is how to judiciously acquire the ground truth by assessing the benefits and costs in order to balance learning efficiency and learning cost. From the information theoretic perspective, a perhaps even more interesting question is how much efficiency might be lost due to this cost. In this paper, we design a novel contextual bandit-based learning algorithm and endow it with the active learning capability. The key feature of our algorithm is that in addition to sending a query to an annotator for the ground truth, prior information about the ground truth learned by the learner is sent together, thereby reducing the query cost. We prove that by carefully choosing the algorithm parameters, the learning regret of the proposed algorithm achieves the same order as that of conventional contextual bandit algorithms in cost-free scenarios, implying that, surprisingly, cost due to acquiring the ground truth does not increase the learning regret in the long-run. Our analysis shows that prior information about the ground truth plays a critical role in improving the system performance in scenarios where active learning is necessary.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究基于上下文的赌博机算法中的主动学习策略，与有限元代理建模或生物力学设计没有直接关联。

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of costly ground truth acquisition in contextual bandit-based sequential decision making.
summary_en.method: A novel contextual bandit algorithm with active learning capability that reduces query cost by sending prior information along with queries.
summary_en.result: The learning regret achieves the same order as conventional algorithms in cost-free scenarios, showing that query cost does not increase long-run regret.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical analysis only, with no experimental or simulation validation.

papers.title: Fabrication of titanium based biphasic scaffold using selective laser melting and collagen immersion
papers.abstract: Tissue engineering approaches have been adopted to address challenges in osteochondral tissue regeneration. Single phase scaffolds, which consist of only one single material throughout the whole structure, have been used extensively in these tissue engineering approaches. However, a single phase scaffold is insufficient in providing all the properties required for regeneration and repair of osteochondral defects. Biphasic scaffolds with two distinct phases of titanium/type 1 c ollagen and titanium-tantalum/type 1 collagen were developed for the first time using selective laser melting and collagen infiltration. Observation of the biphasic scaffolds demonstrated continuous interface between the two phases and mechanical characterization of the metallic scaffolds support the feasibility of the newly developed scaffolds for tissue engineering in osteochondral defects.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发双相支架用于骨软骨缺陷再生修复
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔融和胶原浸润制备钛/胶原双相支架
summary_zh.result: 支架两相界面连续，力学性能支持骨软骨组织工程应用
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试验证支架可行性

summary_en.motivation: To develop a biphasic scaffold for osteochondral tissue regeneration that overcomes the limitations of single-phase scaffolds.
summary_en.method: A biphasic scaffold with titanium/collagen and titanium-tantalum/collagen phases was fabricated using selective laser melting and collagen immersion.
summary_en.result: The biphasic scaffold exhibited a continuous interface between phases and mechanical properties suitable for osteochondral tissue engineering.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical characterization confirmed the feasibility of the scaffold for load-bearing applications.

papers.title: Biodegradable and Bioactive Porous Polymer/Inorganic Nanocomposites Scaffolds for Biomedical Applications

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文综述了用于骨组织工程的生物可降解聚合物/无机纳米复合材料支架，但未涉及LPBF增材制造或应力屏蔽等生物力学问题。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no stress shielding analysis, no surface roughness or osseointegration data.

summary_zh.motivation: 老龄化社会对骨缺损修复材料需求增加。
summary_zh.method: 综述了聚合物/无机纳米复合多孔支架的材料选择与生物活性评价方法。
summary_zh.result: 钙硅基生物陶瓷具有可调的理化性能和优异的生物活性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟体液浸泡评估体外磷灰石形成能力。

summary_en.motivation: The increasing need for bone graft substitutes drives research into bioactive porous scaffolds for tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: This review covers material selection and bioactivity assessment (e.g., SBF immersion) for biodegradable polymer/inorganic nanocomposite scaffolds.
summary_en.result: Calcium silicate-based ceramics show adjustable mechanical properties and excellent in vitro bioactivity.
summary_en.validation: In vitro bioactivity was evaluated via simulated body fluid (SBF) immersion to assess apatite formation.
